```{r build-clb-sce}
# Читаємо інтенсивності CLB з CSV-файлів
csv_files      <- sort(list.files(new_intens_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = FALSE))
sample_ids_clb <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(csv_files)

cell_dfs <- lapply(seq_along(csv_files), function(i) {
  df              <- read.csv(file.path(new_intens_path, csv_files[i]))
  df$sample_id    <- sample_ids_clb[i]
  df$ObjectNumber <- df$Object
  df
})
cells_df <- do.call(rbind, cell_dfs)

# counts матриця: маркери × клітини (той самий порядок що в spe)
marker_cols <- rownames(spe)
counts_mat  <- t(as.matrix(cells_df[, marker_cols]))
cell_ids    <- paste0(cells_df$sample_id, "_", cells_df$ObjectNumber)
colnames(counts_mat) <- cell_ids

unlab_sce <- SingleCellExperiment(
  assays  = list(counts = counts_mat),
  colData = DataFrame(
    sample_id    = cells_df$sample_id,
    ObjectNumber = cells_df$ObjectNumber
  ),
  rowData = rowData(spe)   # channel_name потрібен для compCytof
)
colnames(unlab_sce) <- cell_ids

# compCytof не використовуємо — замінено на прямий asinh
# unlab_sce <- compCytof(
#   unlab_sce, sm,
#   transform = TRUE, cofactor = compensated_exprs_cofactor,
#   isotope_list = isotope_list, overwrite = FALSE
# )

# asinh-трансформація (cofactor = 1, той самий що при навчанні)
assay(unlab_sce, "exprs") <- asinh(assay(unlab_sce, "counts") / compensated_exprs_cofactor)

cat("CLB SCE:", ncol(unlab_sce), "клітин,", nrow(unlab_sce), "маркерів\n")
cat("Assays:", paste(assayNames(unlab_sce), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# Reconstruct feature names from the SPE: same logic as in 01_read_data_Alona.Rmd.
model_features <- rownames(spe)[
  !grepl("DNA|Histone", rownames(spe), ignore.case = TRUE)
]

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(model_features))

indication_columns <- grep(
  "^Indication",
  model_features,
  value = TRUE
)

marker_names <- setdiff(
  model_features,
  indication_columns
)

missing_query_markers <- setdiff(
  marker_names,
  rownames(unlab_sce)
)

if (length(missing_query_markers)) {
  stop(
    "Markers required by the model are missing from spe_all: ",
    paste(missing_query_markers, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

make_X <- function(sce, model_features) {
  indication_features <- grep(
    "^Indication",
    model_features,
    value = TRUE
  )

  marker_features <- setdiff(
    model_features,
    indication_features
  )

  X_expr <- t(
    assay(sce, "exprs")[
      marker_features,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  )

  # indication <- as.character(sce$Indication)
  # X_ind <- vapply(
  #   indication_features,
  #   function(feature) {
  #     level <- sub("^Indication", "", feature)
  #     as.numeric(indication == level)
  #   },
  #   numeric(length(indication))
  # )
  # X_ind <- as.matrix(X_ind)
  # colnames(X_ind) <- indication_features
  # rownames(X_ind) <- colnames(sce)
  # X <- cbind(X_expr, X_ind)
  # X <- X[, model_features, drop = FALSE]

  X <- X_expr
  storage.mode(X) <- "double"

  stopifnot(
    identical(colnames(X), model_features),
    ncol(X) == length(model_features),
    !anyNA(X)
  )

  X
}

X_unlabelled <- make_X(
  unlab_sce,
  model_features = model_features
)

# prediction helper

```{r}
predict_probabilities <- function(model, X, label_mapping) {
  raw_prediction <- predict(
    model,
    newdata = xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(X)
  )

  if (!is.null(dim(raw_prediction))) {
    probability_matrix <- as.matrix(raw_prediction)
  } else {
    by_row <- matrix(
      raw_prediction,
      ncol = length(label_mapping),
      byrow = TRUE
    )

    by_column <- matrix(
      raw_prediction,
      ncol = length(label_mapping),
      byrow = FALSE
    )

    row_error <- mean(abs(rowSums(by_row) - 1))
    column_error <- mean(abs(rowSums(by_column) - 1))

    probability_matrix <- if (row_error <= column_error) {
      by_row
    } else {
      by_column
    }
  }

  if (nrow(probability_matrix) != nrow(X)) {
    stop("Prediction matrix has the wrong number of cells.")
  }

  if (ncol(probability_matrix) != length(label_mapping)) {
    stop(
      "The model returned ", ncol(probability_matrix),
      " classes, but ", length(label_mapping),
      " labels were reconstructed from lab_sce."
    )
  }

  colnames(probability_matrix) <- label_mapping
  rownames(probability_matrix) <- rownames(X)

  probability_matrix
}


```


```{r}
prediction_probability <- predict_probabilities(
  model,
  X_unlabelled,
  label_mapping
)

predicted_label <- label_mapping[
  max.col(prediction_probability, ties.method = "first")
]

```

# Visual inspection of predicted B cells

```{r plot-predicted-b-cells-fn, fig.height=10, fig.width=12}
plot_predicted_cells <- function(
    sce,
    cell_type,
    markers,
    bcg = NULL,
    normalize_images = TRUE,
    input_range = c(0, 0.2),
    sample_ids = NULL,
    n_samples = 5,
    seed = 123
) {
  cells <- sce[, sce$cell_labels == cell_type]

  if (!ncol(cells)) {
    stop("No cells predicted as ", cell_type, " were found.")
  }

  image_names <- unlist(lapply(image_panels, names), use.names = FALSE)
  mask_names <- unlist(lapply(mask_panels, names), use.names = FALSE)

  available_samples <- intersect(
    unique(as.character(cells$sample_id)),
    intersect(image_names, mask_names)
  )

  if (!length(available_samples)) {
    stop("No matching images and masks for ", cell_type, ".")
  }

  if (is.null(sample_ids)) {
    set.seed(seed)

    selected_samples <- sample(
      available_samples,
      min(n_samples, length(available_samples))
    )
  } else {
    selected_samples <- intersect(
      as.character(sample_ids),
      available_samples
    )

    missing_samples <- setdiff(
      as.character(sample_ids),
      available_samples
    )

    if (length(missing_samples)) {
      warning(
        "Samples unavailable or without predicted ",
        cell_type, " cells: ",
        paste(missing_samples, collapse = ", ")
      )
    }

    if (!length(selected_samples)) {
      stop("None of the requested samples are available.")
    }
  }

  if (is.null(bcg)) {
    bcg <- setNames(
      rep(list(c(0.2, 8, 1)), length(markers)),
      markers
    )
  }

  missing_bcg <- setdiff(markers, names(bcg))

  if (length(missing_bcg)) {
    stop(
      "Missing bcg settings for: ",
      paste(missing_bcg, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  bcg <- bcg[markers]

  valid_bcg <- vapply(
    bcg,
    function(x) {
      is.numeric(x) &&
        length(x) == 3L &&
        all(is.finite(x))
    },
    logical(1)
  )

  if (!all(valid_bcg)) {
    stop(
      "Each bcg value must be numeric c(brightness, contrast, gamma)."
    )
  }

  get_selected <- function(panel_list) {
    selected <- lapply(
      panel_list,
      function(panel) {
        panel[names(panel) %in% selected_samples]
      }
    )

    selected <- selected[lengths(selected) > 0]
    combined <- do.call(c, unname(selected))

    combined[selected_samples]
  }

  cur_images <- get_selected(image_panels)
  cur_masks <- get_selected(mask_panels)
  
  if (normalize_images) {
  cur_images <- cytomapper::normalize(
    cur_images,
    separateImages = TRUE
  )

  cur_images <- cytomapper::normalize(
    cur_images,
    inputRange = input_range
  )
}

  cells <- cells[
    ,
    as.character(cells$sample_id) %in% selected_samples
  ]

  message(
    "Selected samples: ",
    paste(selected_samples, collapse = ", ")
  )

  plotPixels(
    image = cur_images,
    mask = cur_masks,
    object = cells,
    cell_id = "ObjectNumber",
    img_id = "sample_id",
    colour_by = markers,
    outline_by = "cell_labels",
    bcg = bcg,
    colour = list(
      cell_labels = setNames("white", cell_type)
    ),
    image_title = list(cex = 0.75, margin = c(5, 5)),
    thick = TRUE
  )
}
```
